title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 135
description: Ten questions on Psalms 135: praise for Yahweh who chose Israel, struck Egypt and kings, and is unlike the idols of the nations.

questions.text: Where do the servants of Yahweh stand, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Psalms 135:1-2 calls on the servants of Yahweh, who stand in Yahweh's house, in the courts of our God's house.

answers.text: At the gates of the city
In the courts of our God's house
On the top of the mountain

questions.text: According to verse 4, what has Yah chosen Israel to be?
questions.explanation: Psalms 135:4 says Yah has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.

questions.text: According to verse 5, above whom is our Lord?
questions.explanation: Psalms 135:5 says, "our Lord is above all gods."

questions.text: Where does Yahweh bring the wind from?
questions.explanation: Psalms 135:7 says he brings the wind out of his treasuries.

answers.text: From the depths of the sea
From the mountains of the north

questions.text: Whose firstborn did he strike, according to verse 8?
questions.explanation: Psalms 135:8 says he struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.

answers.text: Those of the land of Canaan
Those of the city of Babylon
Egypt's, both of man and animal

questions.text: Og was king of which land?
questions.explanation: Psalms 135:11 names Og king of Bashan.

questions.text: What are the idols of the nations made of?
questions.explanation: Psalms 135:15 says the idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

questions.text: What does verse 16 say about the idols' mouths?
questions.explanation: Psalms 135:16 says, "They have mouths, but they can't speak."

questions.text: What does verse 18 say about those who make idols?
questions.explanation: Psalms 135:18 says those who make them will be like them, and so will everyone who trusts in them.

questions.text: Besides the house of Israel and the house of Aaron, which house is called to praise Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Psalms 135:19-20 calls on the house of Israel, the house of Aaron and the house of Levi to praise Yahweh.
